name: The Nar Shaddaa Job
throughline_question: Can a man who has only ever looked out for himself become someone worth following?

acts.name: The Approach
acts.opening_situation: Keth has just dropped out of hyperspace above Nar Shaddaa. His contact Doss has gone dark. A sealed cargo container sits in his hold. An unknown voice on the comm has warned him off the original drop coordinates.
acts.opening_location: Aboard Mira's Luck, approaching Nar Shaddaa orbit
acts.galactic_context: Imperial customs interdiction has tightened across the Y'Toub system following a Rebel supply intercept at Nal Hutta. Hutt Council territorial disputes between Vossk's faction and the Besadii clan have made landing clearances unpredictable — bribes that worked last month now go to the wrong people. An unrelated freighter explosion at Dock 14 yesterday has every security team on the Promenade running nervous.
acts.anchor_description: Keth lands on Nar Shaddaa with the cargo and begins navigating the station, establishing his presence and making initial contact attempts to find Doss or an alternative drop point.
open_threads: Who is the mysterious comm voice?
What is actually in the cargo?

acts.name: The Complication
acts.galactic_context: A Rebel cell has been broken on the Smuggler's Moon — ISB is running sweeps through the mid-levels. Vossk's patience with late deliveries has become a topic of discussion among his intermediaries, and discussions among Hutts have consequences.
acts.anchor_description: Keth discovers what happened to Doss — whether arrested, hiding, or having betrayed him. The truth about his contact's fate forces Keth to reassess the job and his next move.

acts.name: The Squeeze
acts.opening_location: Nar Shaddaa, lower levels near Vossk's territory
acts.galactic_context: The Besadii clan has moved on one of Vossk's subsidiary operations in the lower levels, pulling his enforcers away from the Promenade. For a narrow window, Vossk's grip on this district is weaker than it has been in years.
acts.anchor_description: Vossk's patience runs out. Through intermediaries, enforcers, or a direct message, the weight of Keth's debt makes itself undeniable. The job is no longer optional — it is survive or pay.

acts.name: The Resolution
acts.opening_location: Nar Shaddaa, docking ring and departure corridors
acts.galactic_context: Imperial customs has announced a 48-hour lockdown of all non-essential departures from Nar Shaddaa. Officially, it is a security sweep. Unofficially, someone important lost something valuable, and nobody leaves until it is found.
acts.anchor_description: Keth finds or creates a path to resolve the job — deliver the cargo, negotiate with Vossk, escape Nar Shaddaa, or some combination. The endgame is in motion.

npc_roster.name: Vossk the Patient
npc_roster.motivation: Profit and reputation, in that order.
npc_roster.voice_notes: Always through intermediaries. Formal. Indirect. Never threatens directly — observes possibilities.
behavioral_envelope: Never appears in person during this campaign
Never makes direct threats — always frames consequences as observations
doesnt_know_at_start: What is actually in the cargo

npc_roster.name: Doss
npc_roster.role: Keth's contact — status unknown at campaign start
npc_roster.motivation: Survival — Doss is in over his head and knows it.
npc_roster.voice_notes: Half-sentences and nervous deflections. Talks fast when scared. Loyal in his way but self-preservation wins when it has to.
behavioral_envelope: Never confronts anyone directly — always deflects or runs
